scientific_question: Under matched finite displacement budgets, does frozen rank-4 MN-CSA preserve baseline-correct non-counting behavior better than whole-head actuation?
hypothesis_status: pre-outcome hypothesis; not an established paper claim

dataset.name: GQA balanced validation
dataset.counting_filter_result: zero lexical counting-pattern hits and zero numeric-answer questions; therefore no question is excluded for counting risk

candidate_sampling.rule: one question per image; choose the question minimizing SHA256(seed_string|image_id|question_id), then globally sort by that hash
candidate_sampling.reason: avoid image clustering and avoid post-hoc question-type selection

baseline_population.rule: scan the frozen candidate manifest in candidate_rank order and take the first 1000 examples answered correctly by the frozen baseline model
baseline_population.missing_or_corrupt_images: hard error; do not skip and replace samples based on model behavior

baseline_decoding.prompt_template: Answer the question about the image. Respond with only the short answer, using a single word or short phrase. Do not explain.
baseline_decoding.correctness: exact match after frozen minimal generation cleanup

intervention_stress_test.stage: run only after the N=1000 baseline-correct population is frozen
intervention_stress_test.mn_definition: h = mean_t H_t; d_MN = P_U h / ||P_U h||; H'_t = H_t + lambda * ||h|| * d_MN
intervention_stress_test.purpose: geometry-only off-target stress test; not a deployment-policy evaluation

primary_endpoint.name: mean_break_burden_across_lambda_grid
primary_endpoint.per_sample: b_m(i) = mean_lambda I[intervention prediction != gold], on the frozen baseline-correct population

secondary_endpoints: per-lambda break rate for MN and Whole
per-lambda MN-vs-Whole paired exact McNemar tests
structural and semantic question-type subgroup summaries
